corrects: The original preregistration described one long RTX6000 lease and two monolithic reciprocal passes.
scientific_change: none; cohort, models, parameters, policies, metrics, anti-adaptation rule and promotion gates are unchanged
reason: A 175-movie monolithic process would exceed the shared-resource policy's preferred approximately two-hour checkpointable chunk and would have poor interruption recovery.

chunking.ordering: lexicographic within target prefix, frozen before data inference
chunking.policy: Acquire one RTX6000 lease per ready chunk, run only one Biohub GPU job at a time, release after verified process exit, and rejoin the queue tail under contention.

anti_adaptation: Do not open per-movie metrics, chunk summaries or scientific logs until all eight chunks are complete and merged. Operational exit status, file existence, hashes and schema/count validation may be checked.
resume: Each chunk has a unique run directory and immutable movie list. Completed chunks are never recomputed; an interrupted chunk may reuse only its own verified caches after diagnosis.
